clips.title: The story
paras: Lunar Fungus grows in Darkshore's caves, where druids gather it for healing. Mixed with Earthroot and water, it helps make a salve for sick deer.

Lunar Fungus grows from Lunar Fungal Blooms in Darkshore's underground caverns. The Cenarion Circle values its amplifying effects. Mixed with soothing water and common Earthroot, it lends potency to a salve that counters debilitating afflictions. Damp caves where it grows are also frequented by territorial moonkin, so gathering it means navigating carefully.

In Auberdine, Alanndarian Nightsong has young druids gather Lunar Fungus as part of their studies in nature's healing arts. They see how physical ingredients such as this fungus can counter poisons in local deer. By learning how herbal remedies work, initiates prepare to channel natural antidotes through shapeshifting and spiritual power.
